title_en: I Want to Be Beside You
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Clearly a modern composed song, but I cannot name an author, so origin unclear. 'луња' (used for madness/moon) I read as 'madness' (Macedonian 'луња' can mean a whim); a guess.

lines.cyr: Потпри се на градиве
lines.lat: Potpri se na gradive
lines.en: Lean on this chest of mine

lines.cyr: да ја сетиш таа возбуда
lines.lat: da ja setiš taa vozbuda
lines.en: to feel that excitement

lines.cyr: и тој оган што не запира,
lines.lat: i toj ogan što ne zapira,
lines.en: and that fire that does not stop,

lines.cyr: да го згасниш во себеси.
lines.lat: da go zgasniš vo sebesi.
lines.en: to put it out within yourself.

lines.cyr: Сакам да ти влезам во срцето,
lines.lat: Sakam da ti vlezam vo srceto,
lines.en: I want to enter your heart,

lines.cyr: ноќе да ти спијам во очите,
lines.lat: noḱe da ti spijam vo očite,
lines.en: to sleep at night in your eyes,

lines.cyr: тајно да ти умрам во душата,
lines.lat: tajno da ti umram vo dušata,
lines.en: to die secretly in your soul,

lines.cyr: сакам да сум крај тебе.
lines.lat: sakam da sum kraj tebe.
lines.en: I want to be beside you.

lines.en: Touch this face of mine

lines.cyr: за да сетиш дел од животов,

lines.en: to feel a part of this life,

lines.cyr: таа луња што не запира

lines.en: that madness that does not stop,

lines.lat: da ja skrotiš vo sebesi.
lines.en: to tame it within yourself.
